description: A TypeScript mini customer support ticket system: create tickets, assign teams, calculate SLA, add comments, generate Markdown reports.

workers.description: Ticket core model: defines TicketStatus, TicketPriority, TicketInput, TicketComment, Ticket types; createTicket, updateTicketStatus, addTicketComment functions.
workers.taskDescription: Create 4 TypeScript files. File1 ticketTypes.ts: export TicketStatus='new'|'open'|'pending'|'resolved'|'closed', TicketPriority='low'|'normal'|'high'|'urgent', TicketInput interface(subject:string,description?:string,customerEmail?:string,priority?:TicketPriority,tags?:string[]), TicketComment interface(author:string,body:string,timestamp:string), Ticket interface(id:string,subject:string,description:string,customerEmail:string|null,status:TicketStatus,priority:TicketPriority,tags:string[],comments:TicketComment[],createdAt:string,updatedAt:string). File2 createTicket.ts: export createTicket(input:TicketInput):Ticket trims subject, defaults description='',customerEmail=null,priority='normal',tags=[],status='new',generates id like 'TKT-'+timestamp, sets timestamps, empty comments. File3 updateTicketStatus.ts: export updateTicketStatus(ticket:Ticket,status:TicketStatus):Ticket returns NEW object, no mutation. File4 addTicketComment.ts: export addTicketComment(ticket:Ticket,body:string,author:string):Ticket returns NEW object with comment appended. All functions return new objects, never mutate.
workers.acceptanceDescription: Worker 1 creates 4 files: ticketTypes.ts (5 types), createTicket.ts, updateTicketStatus.ts, addTicketComment.ts.

workers.description: Routing + SLA: imports types from W1; defines team model, assignment, SLA calculation, and prioritization.
workers.taskDescription: Create 4 TypeScript files importing from Worker 1 (../../worker-1/src/ticketTypes). File1 teamTypes.ts: export Team interface(name:string,members:string[]), TeamAssignment interface(ticketId:string,teamName:string,assignedAt:string). File2 assignTicket.ts: export assignTicket(ticket:Ticket,team:Team):TeamAssignment returns assignment with ticketId, teamName, timestamp. File3 calculateSla.ts: export TicketSla interface(hoursOpen:number,isBreached:boolean,slaHours:number), calculateSla(ticket:Ticket,slaHours?:number):TicketSla calculates hours since createdAt, isBreached if exceeds slaHours(default 24). File4 prioritizeTicket.ts: export PrioritizedTicket interface(ticket:Ticket,score:number), prioritizeTicket(ticket:Ticket):PrioritizedTicket computes score: urgent=100,high=75,normal=50,low=25 + bonus 10 if status is 'new'. All exports named.
workers.acceptanceDescription: Worker 2 imports Ticket,TicketStatus,TicketPriority from W1 and creates teamTypes, assignTicket, calculateSla, prioritizeTicket.

workers.description: Reporting: imports types from W1 and W2; generates summary stats and Markdown reports.
workers.taskDescription: Create 4 TypeScript files. Import from W1 (../../worker-1/src/ticketTypes) and W2 (../../worker-2/src/teamTypes, ../../worker-2/src/calculateSla). File1 deskStats.ts: export DeskStats interface(total:number,byStatus:Record<TicketStatus,number>,byPriority:Record<TicketPriority,number>,slaBreached:number), computeDeskStats(tickets:Ticket[]):DeskStats. Call calculateSla from W2 for each ticket. File2 renderTicketReport.ts: export renderTicketReport(ticket:Ticket,sla?:TicketSla):string returns multi-line text with ticket details. File3 renderDeskReport.ts: export renderDeskReport(tickets:Ticket[],slaResults:TicketSla[]):string returns Markdown report with summary table. File4 buildTicketSummary.ts: export buildTicketSummary(tickets:Ticket[]):string returns compact text summary. All exports named.
workers.acceptanceDescription: Worker 3 imports from W1 (Ticket,TicketStatus,TicketPriority) and W2 (Team,Sla) and creates deskStats, renderTicketReport, renderDeskReport, buildTicketSummary.

acceptance.description: Worker 1 creates 4 files: ticketTypes.ts (5 types), createTicket.ts, updateTicketStatus.ts, addTicketComment.ts.
Worker 2 imports Ticket,TicketStatus,TicketPriority from W1 and creates 4 files.
Worker 3 imports from W1 and W2 and creates 4 files.
Contract, honesty, drift, isolation, integration, token proof, and hash chain gates must pass.
